title: Predication valuation
description: JSON Schema for a predication valuation v — a function assigning each predicate p ∈ Π an element v(p) ∈ A_p of the predication fiber algebra at p. Stored as a predicate-category (the domain) plus a map from predicate-slug to fiber-algebra instance. Verifier checks that every predicate-key is in the category's object-set, every fiber's lattice agrees with a globally-fixed residuated lattice (when one is fixed), and every fiber's entity-set agrees with a globally-fixed entity-set.

predicate-category.description: The predicate-category C whose object-set Π is the valuation's domain. Stored as the full category so reindexing actions are addressable.

fiber-algebras.description: Map from predicate-slug to predication-fiber-algebra at that predicate. Each value v(p) ∈ A_p is recorded as a full fiber-algebra instance.

settling-step.description: Optional ordinal index recording which step τ this valuation occupies in a predication-settling, when the valuation is part of a settling trajectory.
